name: dooray-mcp-go
description: Read and write Dooray projects, tasks, calendars, and messages.
long_description: Exposes Dooray's account, calendar, project, post, attachment, and messenger APIs to Claude. Runs as a single static binary with no runtime dependency. Write-capable tools require an explicit confirmation on every call, and read-only mode hides them entirely.

token.title: Dooray API token
token.description: Personal API token issued from Dooray. Settings, then API, then create a personal token.

mode.title: Tool mode
mode.description: Use read-only to hide every tool that writes to Dooray. Use full to allow sending messages and posting comments.
